China Hosts World AI Conference, Xi Jinping Calls for Collaboration

China's World Artificial Intelligence Conference 2026 has opened, featuring displays of humanoid robots. President Xi Jinping addressed the conference, advocating for global cooperation in the field of artificial intelligence. The event highlights China's role in advancing AI technology and its push for international partnerships.
